title: 102nd Civil Engineers Tornado Response on Cape Cod
description:
Airmen from the Massachusetts Air National Guard’s 102nd Civil Engineer Squadron mobilized on July 25, 2019 to clear fallen trees and debris in Dennis Port, Mass. in support recovery efforts in the wake of three tornadoes that touched down on Cape Cod. 

The Massachusetts National Guard’s response to the emergency is aimed at assisting the region to return to business as usual as quickly as possible.

Music by Air Force Band Max Impact - Send Me
